text: Some of the most important discoveries in the Lands Between, such as underground cities, hidden questlines, and optional bosses, are not indicated by the Sites of Grace guidance.

Fan theories propose that the puppets found in the hidden basement behind Caria Manor, including a Nox, an Omenkiller, Dolores the Sleeping Arrow, Finger Maiden Therolina, a Jarwright, and a hidden Sellen puppet, may all belong to Seluvis.
Theories suggest the Omenkiller puppet may have been meant to frame Gideon Ofnir for the slaughter in the Albinauric village, disillusioning Nephali.
Hewg the Blacksmith was assigned by Queen Marika to forge a weapon capable of slaying God but was unable to complete it in time, as stated in his dialogue.
